Value: sow_and_subscribe
The target SOW topic to query and subscribe.

Acknowledgment type for the given command.
Value is a comma separated string of one or more of the
following: none, received, processed, completed or stats.

Number of records to return in a single sow query results
message.
The AMPS server default value is 1.
It is recommended to use a higher value, as even small
increases can yield greater performance in query result
delivery. Current AMPS client libraries provide a batch size of
10 by default.
The BatchSize header only applies to the sow query.
